indicator_name: Targeted transfers from the National Fund to the republican budget, year-to-date, monthly
description: Целевые трансферты из Национального фонда в республиканский бюджет, нарастающим итогом с начала года, помесячно
methodology: Million KZT (source: thousand KZT), National Fund of the Republic of Kazakhstan, targeted transfers to the republican budget, YEAR-TO-DATE cumulative (January to the month dated): the report 'as of 1 <month>' is dated the month before, 'as of 1 January' is December. From every Minfin 'Statement of receipts and application of the National Fund' in the listing (106 of 106 parsed; the approved annual reports for 2018 and 2024 stand in for the missing reports as of 1 January 2019 and 2025; the latest posting wins, 1 revised point(s) across the series). Every report passes seven taxes = direct taxes on the oil sector. History: none (KGD does not publish this line). Months no report covers are missing, not interpolated.
